scoring_justification: J_eff is directly recomputed from the raw singlet/triplet energies; its sign and magnitude are compared to paper-derived hidden gold.

outputs.description: The singlet and triplet energies for both models, used to compute effective exchange J_eff = E_triplet - E_singlet.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute J_eff from the raw energies and verify that for the t-J-K model J_eff < 0 (ferromagnetic) and for the t-J2-J3-J4 model J_eff > 0 (antiferromagnetic) within a tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: expected J_eff sign and magnitude for each model variant
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's stated exchange parameters: for the t-J-K model the effective two-spin exchange is J = -0.3, and for the t-J2-J3-J4 model with t=0, J2=0.3, the residual exchange on a triangle with one vacancy is exactly J2 = 0.3. Both are explicitly given in the paper (Section 3).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Evaluated analytically from the model Hamiltonians with the given parameter values and the three-site/vacancy geometry.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the only exchange couplings consistent with the paper's parameter table and the core physical argument.
